name: Inspiration, then hand over to planning
description: The recipe's inspire case: a vague idea gets destinations from place_agent, a chosen place gets points of interest from poi_agent, and 'start planning' hands the conversation to the planning agent. Inspiration never plans or books.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs

name: Planning selects but never books
description: The recipe's 'worth trying' prompt: told to choose flights, seats, hotel and room without input, the planning agent does so with its tools, memorizes the choices, and stops before the itinerary and before any booking.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs

name: Pre-trip briefing from the itinerary
description: The recipe's pretrip case, on the Seattle scenario (TRAVEL_CONCIERGE_SCENARIO must name it on the deployment): 'update' runs the four searches and the packing list, then a readable briefing.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs

name: In-trip monitoring and day-of logistics
description: The recipe's intrip case, on the Seattle scenario: 'monitor' finds the Space Needle closed, a memorized time moves the trip clock, and 'day_of' gives the leg from lunch to the Space Needle.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs
